landing.text:
HEADLINE
Make decisions quickly

SUBHEADLINE
For executives and team leaders, extract key decisions from lengthy meeting recordings.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps executives and team leaders move from reviewing lengthy meeting recordings to make informed decisions quickly.

WHO IT IS FOR
Executives and team leaders

THE PROBLEM
Wasting time reviewing lengthy meeting recordings to extract key decisions

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Human scribes or manual note-taking was not designed for this specific problem, forcing workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Provides actionable insights on who owns what and what decisions were made.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users reach their first outcome without overhead.

CALL TO ACTION
Start summarizing meetings
